name: HHS ASPE — Welfare Indicators and Risk Factors, 25th Report to Congress: Indicator 4 (participation among the eligible)
organization: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, Office of the Assistant Secretary for Planning and Evaluation

model.name: TRIM3 (Urban Institute, for HHS) for TANF and SSI; FNS's SNAP participation series for SNAP
model.method: Indicator 4 is the share of people (TANF families, SNAP households, SSI adult units) who receive a benefit among those eligible, in an average month. TANF and SSI eligibility and participation are simulated by TRIM3 on the CPS ASEC; the SNAP series combines FNS program operations, SNAP QC and the CPS ASEC.
model.method_basis: 25th report, Indicator 4 definition; Appendix Tables 10-12 notes and source lines

period: TANF select years 1981-2023; SNAP September 1976 to FY 2022 (no FY 2021); SSI 1993-2023 (counts from 1998)
routing_note: SNAP participating households (Table 11) are FNS program-operations counts — administrative, so dropped from claims under the 2026-08-02 boundary ruling. TANF and SSI participating counts are TRIM3 simulation output and stay claims.
vintage_note: Table 11 marks methodological breaks (series consistent within 1976-1994, 1994-1999, FY1999-2001, FY2002-2009, FY2010-2016). Table 10 excludes small supplemental-only benefits from 2017. Table 12 carries an erratum for 2013-2016 (corrected in this edition).
diagnosis_upstream: TRIM3 is not public; divergences classified as external-model issues become a comparison memo.
